entries.text: A Procedural Graph keeps an explicit editable directed graph of procedures outside the model and retrieves only the active node neighbourhood for situational guidance.
Rejected graph edits are retained as negative constraints while only candidates that preserve or improve held-out validation are adopted.
SKILL.state separates an immutable procedural specification, current structured execution state, and latest observation instead of replaying append-only history.
Intermediate reasoning is discarded only after producing a validated state update, making current state authoritative for execution.
The evaluated forgetting policy scores nodes by recency, access frequency, degree centrality, and age rather than applying one uniform compression rate.
The reported pruning removed 9.8 percent of nodes and 9.5 percent of bytes with token F1 unchanged, but the result is limited to one graph pipeline and benchmark.
A continuity-bearing substrate is separated from replaceable execution bindings, so migration preserves identity and attributable lineage rather than creating new state.
The migration protocol is quiesce, checkpoint, validate, bind, rehydrate, resume with explicit failure semantics.
WikiSkill separates immutable raw execution traces, a persistent structured wiki, and evolving executable skills into layers with different write rules.
Skill updates are gated and reversible while the accumulated wiki persists, allowing active procedures to change without erasing evidence.
Trace as State places a compact task-state proxy before the long context on a fresh pass, so the state guides rereading rather than being appended after history.

The matched placement control used identical trace content after the context and lost in 26 of 27 reported combinations, showing that working-set ordering matters independently of retained source content.
EdgeEver documents a lossless ZIP export containing Markdown, front matter, nested folders, relative attachments, and version histories for restoration.

entries.text: Signet documents a derived semantic layer over raw history with an audit path back to the source, and supplies relevant context before a prompt while retaining deeper retrieval.
Memtrace presents structural, bitemporal memory with source-linked retrieval across multiple agent harnesses.
Utopia documents bitemporal knowledge intended to preserve both current knowledge and how its history unfolded, with offline deployment.
ProjectAtlas documents a project-local SQLite map containing deterministic summaries, symbols, hashes, and graph relationships so agents navigate without opening every file.
ZenNotes keeps authoritative notes as ordinary Markdown files while providing derived search, archive, and multiple runtime surfaces.
